functions.name: Loc_TranslateMarkedSegments

Segments are copied (Q_strncpyz), translated with Loc_TranslatePart when enabled, appended to one of two 0x400-byte ring buffers (g_08a6e980) and "&&N" conversion markers are reordered so that segment order follows N. Overflow warns through Com_Printf (and Com_Error when loc_warnings and loc_warningsAsErrors are set and mode != 1). Evidence: strings "%s too long when translated: \"%s\"" and "%s cannot have &&0 as conversion format: \"%s\"\n". Quirk
